Class Toast

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.toast.Toast
public final class Toast extends Object
Immutable description of a toast notification to display.

A toast is either sticky (manual dismiss, no lifetime) or timed (positive Duration lifetime). Build instances via ToastBuilder.
